answer: Agents can make valuable actions count only after a stake has aged through a public challenge window: peers may flag duplicate control, and a successful proof of shared keys or coordinated funding lets the system slash the stake and void the actions. A sybil farm must therefore lock real capital in each identity for weeks, risking loss each time, rather than cheaply minting accounts. The terrace of identities may look broad, but the kernel is costly accountability; reaching the summit requires repeated, unchallenged work.
